text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, prochlorperazine 25 mg suppositories are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 139 units at 7.8 per day (17.9 days). Corvale General holds 161 units at 8.6 per day (18.8 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 26 units at 1.5 per day (17.9 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list does not include prochlorperazine as of 2026-10-21. A product label identifies PD-Rx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (FEI 1641825) as a registered repack plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-08-20.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately 18 days of supply across sites. The top ranked alternate source is Cosette Pharmaceuticals, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, but its label names no manufacturing plant we could verify. Padagis US LLC is a second option, also not on the shortage list, with no identifiable plant on its label.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies the Cosette product label for a named manufacturing plant and confirms its FDA inspection status before purchase; buyer approves.
2. If Cosette verification fails, buyer verifies the Padagis product label for a named manufacturing plant and confirms its FDA inspection status before purchase; buyer approves.
3. Buyer monitors daily usage and inventory at all three sites and reports supply days to the P&T committee weekly; P&T committee approves monitoring plan.

Not recommended: Switching to an alternate supplier without confirming the manufacturing plant identity and its current FDA inspection status.
